rubrics.justification: Mostly reasonable but somewhat inconsistent with the provided 4AA/hatching label; the response notes no obvious zona breach or hatching and describes the ICM/TE more cautiously than the reported grade supports.
Comprehensively integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor diagnosis, prior live birth, BMI, endometrium, sperm parameters, and smoking with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logical and well-structured, with a clear link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis; minor tension between questioning the morphology and still accepting the reported 4AA grade.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice and Gardner-based interpretation, including single embryo transfer, luteal support, smoking cessation, and selective PGT-A discussion; slight overreach in image-based re-grading limits a perfect score.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer management, counseling, smoking cessation, nutritional support, and contingency planning for future cycles.
